mapper.sql: select id, title, image_url, link_url, sort_no, enabled, description, created_time, created_by, updated_time, updated_by from banner
mapper.insert: insert into banner (title, image_url, link_url, sort_no, enabled, description, created_time, updated_time, created_by, updated_by) values (#{title}, #{imageUrl}, #{linkUrl}, #{sortNo}, #{enabled}, #{description}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
